column1: # Single source of truth for the plugin hooks setup.sh registers and teardown
# Tab-separated, one row per hook; lines starting with # and blank lines are
#   matcher  Tool matcher regex, or - for an event with no matcher.
#   feature  The --skip/--include feature (plugin directory) that owns the hook.
#   script   Hook script, relative to ~/.claude/skills/ (where setup.sh links plugins).
#   legacy   Retired .sh path for the same row, relative to ~/.claude/skills/.
# Why TSV, not JSON: bash needs no parser or python3 to read it, and an empty
# field is spelled - because a tab is IFS whitespace and `read` would collapse
